about.title: I'm <mark>Arnaud</mark>.
about.p1: I'm a fullstack developer. I started coding in 2022, during my BUT MMI in Meaux. Today I'm a work-study student at Kollirama, in Bernis, and doing a Master's at EPSI Montpellier.
about.p2: I've also been freelancing since February 2026. My first client was Atelier Maha, an interior design studio.
about.p3: In the evenings, I work on my own projects, like Quested or Tengo!. And when I'm not coding, I play video games :)
